title: Tsoureki
subtitle: Mahlab + Tonka Trial
description: A braided Greek Easter bread plan built around mahlab's bitter cherry-almond character, with tonka extending it into vanilla, hay, and marzipan. The point is to use the spices already in the cabinet without pretending the formula is settled.
source: Spice-cabinet planning conversation; base formula TBD
notes: The whole point is to use the mahlab and tonka already in the cabinet, not to engineer a generic Easter bread.
Regulatory curiosity: the FDA lists coumarin as prohibited for use as a flavoring agent or adjuvant under 21 CFR 189.130.

deviations.what: Tonka bean in the tsoureki spice profile
deviations.why: Extends mahlab's bitter cherry-almond character into vanilla, hay, and marzipan while using the beans already on hand.
